messages:
emily: Need to request a privileged SIEM export for a vuln triage. Window: 2026-07-12T08:30:00Z -> 2026-07-12T09:45:00Z. Looking for signoff and RBAC pattern.
tom: tag me. what's the minimum fields we need? avoid emails/SSNs if possible.
emily: fields: user_id, event, ip, timestamp, device_id. We want to hash user_id, redact email, mask ip to /24, and drop tokens.
infra-kate: for exports we prefer per-export salt in vault and a named CMK per class (alias/al_vuln_ephemeral). Do you want ephemeral KMS (one-time) or reuse a scoped CMK?
emily: ephemeral would be ideal for this triage since we dont want long-lived decrypt rights. Plan: ephemeral HSM-backed key with 6h life, pre-signed download URL valid 4h, snapshot auto-delete after 48h.
auditor-rahul: policy: ephemeral exports need 2 approvers OR auditor + oncall. Must include SALT in vault://sec/<ticket>/salt and an auditable reason field on grant. Also require MFA for unwrap.
security-bot: runbook checklist: 1) ticket created 2) salt in vault 3) infra PR for temp role 4) KMS request for ephemeral HSM key 5) audit hook enabled 6) oncall assigned. Any missing step blocks.
emily: created ticket SEC-2999. Requesting role "triage-exporter" with permissions ["siem:read:limited","siem:export:ephemeral"] duration 3h. Auditor: @auditor-rahul. Oncall: @oncall-maya.
oncall-maya: i'm available during window; can do MFA unwrap. Please include exact curl/aws steps in the ticket.
tom: can we tighten the role to the single export resource instead of global SIEM read? otherwise approval will be slow.
infra-kate: yes. PR will add resource-scoped role and a lambda to enforce deletion lifecycle. I'll open PR and include reviewers @sre @seceng.
emily: SIEM query (approx):
```
auth.events
| where timestamp >= "2026-07-12T08:30:00Z" and timestamp <= "2026-07-12T09:45:00Z"
| where event in ("login_success","login_failed")
| fields user_id,email,ip,event,timestamp,device_id
```
Scrub rules: user_id->sha256(user_id+SALT), email->"[redacted]", ip->mask_last_octet, drop oauth_token. Destination: ephemeral-kms://SEC-2999/ with CMK alias/al_vuln_ephemeral. Retention: delete after 48h.
auditor-rahul: require SALT stored at vault://sec/SEC-2999/salt and that the SALT be rotated post-delete. Require audit fields: grant_reason, grant_by, unwrap_mfa, unwrap_by, delete_time.
infra-kate: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3055 - adds triage-exporter role, resource scoping, and lifecycle lambda. reviewers: @sre @seceng.
oncall-maya: add me to unwrap principals. Also need the MFA command sample so I can follow it exactly.
emily: sample export request (will reference SALT in ticket):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://siem.internal/api/v1/exports" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"<above query>", "scrub_rules":[{"field":"user_id","action":"sha256+salt","salt_ticket":"SEC-2999"},{"field":"email","action":"redact"},{"field":"ip","action":"mask_last_octet"}], "destination":"ephemeral-kms://SEC-2999","kms_alias":"alias/al_vuln_ephemeral"}'
```
security-bot: infra PR merged. KMS request KMS-1603 filed for ephemeral HSM key. awaiting KMS-ops. Ticket SEC-2999 updated.
auditor-rahul: KMS-ops approval required; will sign once KMS key_policy restricts Decrypt to triage-exporter role + oncall principal and unwrap logs to audit service.
infra-kate: KMS-1603 approved with HSM provenance and expiry 6h. Key policy limits Decrypt to role ARN and oncall-Maya ARN.
ombot: audit check: grant and unwrap events streaming to auditlog service.
'emily': kicking export job now. export id=TX-11223. pre-signed URL valid 4h from 2026-07-12T08:35:00Z.
oncall-maya: performed MFA unwrap, downloaded file, verified scrub rules applied. Audit entries present: grant=authz#TX-11223, decrypt=crypto#TX-11223, download=net#TX-11223, delete scheduled.
auditor-rahul: confirmed audit fields present and SALT used. closing approval.
emily: snapshot completed and set for deletion in 48h. follow-ups: add a "triage export" template to docs and a linter to ensure exports to ephemeral destinations do not write to S3.
tom: good idea. also add a CI check on infra PRs to flag broad SIEM permissions.
infra-kate: filing INF-5110 for linter/CI check.
security-bot: SEC-2999 closed. postmortem requested in ticket with suggested templates.
emily: thanks all. will draft the template and link back to SEC-2999 for future reference."
